# coss UI component skill — Base UI primitives with a shadcn-like DX

Curated by Skill Harbor — @cosscom's skill for using coss UI components correctly: a component library built on Base UI with a shadcn-like developer experience plus a large particle catalog. The skill teaches picking the right primitive for a UI task, writing correct usage code (imports, composition, props), avoiding common shadcn/Radix migration mistakes, and referencing particle examples for practical production-like patterns. All 54 primitives have dedicated reference guides (dialog, menu, context-menu, select, form, input-group, toast and more) with a component-registry index; rule files cover styling (Tailwind tokens, icon conventions, data-slot selectors), forms, composition (trigger/popup hierarchies, grouped controls), migration, segmented-control choices and portal props. Critical usage rules: never invent coss APIs — verify against the docs first; preserve trigger/content hierarchies for Dialog/Menu/Select/Popover/Tooltip; keep accessibility labels and error semantics; prefer styled exports and use `*Primitive` exports only when custom composition requires it; consult the high-risk primitive guides before the trickiest ones. Install via `npx shadcn@latest add @coss/<component>` or manually (dependencies + copy component files + fix imports), with sources of truth at the repo's docs, particle registry, `coss.com/ui/particles` and the docs `llms.txt` for agents. Honest caveats: **requires Tailwind CSS v4 and @base-ui/react** — not drop-in for other setups; **license...
